vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 40s, with a limp and A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm are arguing about the watch rotation. Again. It's almost comforting.
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sets out to find Bao. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Charlotte, Kelsey, Bao, Eduardo and Hugo met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Charlotte, Kelsey, Bao, Eduardo, Hugo are hurt.
🛡️ Hugo, Nathan, Nino, Victor and Ines met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Hugo, Nathan, Nino, Victor are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Eduardo just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nathan just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Charlotte just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jovan just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Devon taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Benoit showed Ursula the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
